title: Cafda Village, Retreat (Bernstein Rd, approx.): man, 41, shot dead, three young men wounded, 18 Oct
summary: Police say four people were shot on Bernstein Road near the Retreat Community Health Centre, in Cafda Village, on Sunday 18 October; police responded at about 15:30. A man of 41 died, and three young men aged 16 to 21 we...
story: Police say four people were shot on Bernstein Road near the Retreat Community Health Centre, in Cafda Village, on Sunday 18 October; police responded at about 15:30. A man of 41 died, and three young men aged 16 to 21 were wounded (Smile 90.4FM, quoting police spokesperson Wesley Twigg). Steenberg police are investigating murder and attempted murder cases. No motive and no arrest have been reported. The clinic was locked down after the shooting and reopened on 19 October (Department of Health and Wellness). The victims were not named. Three reports, all resting on police: Smile 90.4FM, IOL (Cape Times; Cape Argus ran the same story) and Southern Mail, which also quotes the provincial Health Department.
incident: Sun 18 Oct 2026, police responded at about 15:30 (police, via Smile 90.4FM)
location_note: Bernstein Road, Cafda Village, Retreat, near the Retreat Community Health Centre (police, via Smile 90.4FM). Exact spot not given. The pin is the middle of Bernstein Road, a short street (about 160 m) in OpenStreetMap.

provenance.statement_from: SAPS Western Cape, quoted by Smile 90.4FM, IOL and Southern Mail
other_voices: Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness (Monique Johnstone)
provenance.note: Three reports, all resting on police. IOL ran one story twice (Cape Times and Cape Argus), so it counts once. Southern Mail also quotes the provincial Health Department, which speaks only about the clinic closure.

facts.label: Deaths
facts.detail: Three other males aged 16 to 21 wounded (police, via Smile 90.4FM: 'injured'; IOL: 'seriously injured'). IOL Cape Times adds that the man was declared dead at the scene. Briefly News gives the wounded ages as 16, 18 and 21 without saying where that comes from. All three news reports relay one police account; repetition by IOL is not independent corroboration.

sources.name: Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape spokesperson (via Smile 90.4FM)
sources.quote: one 41-year-old man was killed in the incident

facts.label: Date and time
facts.claim: Sunday 18 October, police responded at about 15:30.
facts.detail: 15:30 is when police responded, not a stated time of the shooting; IOL writes the shooting 'occurred at about 3:30 pm'. The day comes from 'on Sunday' in a report dated 19 October. The health department notice separately dates a 'safety incident outside the facility' to 18 October; it does not mention a shooting.

sources.name: Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape spokesperson (via Smile 90.4FM)
sources.quote: He noted that police responded to the incident at around 15:30.

facts.label: Place
facts.claim: Bernstein Road, Cafda Village, Retreat, near the Retreat Community Health Centre (street level).
facts.detail: The exact spot on the road is not given. Briefly News says 'Bernstein Street', unattributed; recorded as a detail, not a conflict of comparable standing. The health notice places the incident 'outside the facility'.

sources.name: SAPS Western Cape, as reported by Smile 90.4FM
sources.quote: four people were shot on Bernstein Road near the clinic, in Cafda Village, on Sunday

facts.label: Method
facts.detail: IOL: 'suffered fatal gunshot wounds'. Police say suspects in a vehicle opened fire, 'according to reports'.

sources.name: SAPS Western Cape, as reported by Smile 90.4FM
sources.quote: The Western Cape SAPS confirmed that four people were shot

facts.label: Reported motive
facts.claim: None reported; police say the circumstances are under investigation.
facts.detail: No gang or other motive is attributed in any saved report. The police account of what happened ('According to reports' the victims were standing in the road when suspects in a vehicle opened fire) describes circumstances, not motive. IOL says 'alongside the road'.

sources.name: Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape spokesperson (via Smile 90.4FM)
sources.quote: The circumstances surrounding the incident are under investigation

facts.label: Legal status
facts.claim: Murder and attempted murder cases opened by Steenberg police; no arrest reported.
facts.detail: No report says whether anyone was arrested; 'no arrest reported' means none is mentioned as of the 19 October reports. Current arrest or court status was not checked.

sources.name: Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape spokesperson (via Smile 90.4FM)
sources.quote: Twigg confirmed that Steenberg police are investigating murder and attempted murder cases
